name: player_check_probe_sample_mask_overlap
description: Player::CheckProbeSampleMaskOverlap returns the shared bit mask for three environment probe sample indices.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player environment-probe selector pass so table placement and caller inlining context can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x42cbd0 validates that the return value is the bitwise AND of g_PlayerEnvProbeSampleMaskTable for sampleIndexA, sampleIndexB, and sampleIndexC.
The native smoke verifies both nonzero overlap and zero-overlap combinations against the recovered probe sample mask table.
